messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring OOMs on kv-shard-4. want to lock owners and a cadence for remediation items. short list: profiling exports, GC tuning, soft/eviction limits, runbook + recurring checks. timeline suggestions?

arjun: I can take profiling exports. will run heap dump / perf this week and generate flamegraphs. planning: perf record -g -p $PID && perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded && flamegraph.pl out.folded.

carmen: I will own the heap-scan job + artifact uploads. pushing results to s3://redwood-debug/kv-shard-4/ by EOW. will also run our new slab-residency scanner.

patrick: +1 on profiling. also propose a temporary soft_limit bump to 65% for the shard to reduce noisy evictions while we triage. canary to 10% of fleet for 24h. we saw evictions spike at ~62% in last incident.

maria: timeline proposal: profiling artifacts by Wed (arjun), heap-scan + scanner by Thu (carmen), soft_limit canary Thu night (patrick), runbook draft updated by Fri (maria/carol). retrospective check-in next Tue.

carol: can take runbook edit with maria. will add explicit rollback steps, commands, and a playbook entry: how to trigger kv-evict, how to run slab-gc, and how to revert soft_limit.

arjun: found suspicious long-lived allocations in kv-alloc map during local replay. attaching snippet of the log pattern (will upload full trace):
```
[2026-03-22T17:02:12Z] kv_alloc: shard=4 alloc_size=131072 site=EncodeBulk(0x7f8f) residency_ms=1.2e6
[2026-03-22T17:02:12Z] kv_resident: shard=4 total_resident=4.9G target=4.0G
```

carmen: observed fragmentation signature in slab stats -> many small free blocks but high RSS. suggests fragmentation, not just leaks. will include fragmentation heatmap.

patrick: if fragmentation confirmed we should schedule a canary with vacuums/slab-defrag routine after-hours. need SRE sync for impact window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: agree. make canary window Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC. carol, can you coordinate with oncall to get approval?

carol: yep, I'll ping oncall and add the window to the runbook. also adding a short checklist for canary rollback: 1) revert soft_limit 2) trigger slab-defrag stop 3) scale-down canary nodes.

arjun: note on artifacts — I'll post flamegraphs + perf.data tarball to the thread when ready. will also include the command I used to collect kv-alloc traces.

patrick: alerting change: add a rule for "ghost_residency_delta" with 5m and 30m windows and auto-page at severity P2. that should catch the stealth growth we saw.

maria: owners summary: profiling=arjun, heap-scan/uploads=carmen, soft_limit canary=patrick, runbook+window=carol+maria, alerting=patrick. recurring check cadence = biweekly 30m slot owned by Maria.

carol: raising a follow-up action: add a weekly job to synthesize residency growth trends and post CSV to /alerts/kv-residency. I'll add to calendar.

arjun: small note: please keep perf collection to low-sample rate on prod; I'll share my instrumentation knobs.

carmen: uploading initial heap-scan now (link: https://s3.redwood.internal/kv-shard-4/scan-3786543210.tar.gz) :link:

sre-bot: runbook-draft created by carol: https://docs.redwood.io/runbooks/kv-residency-defrag-draft — comments open.

maria: thanks everyone. will convert these into tracked actions in the postmortem doc and link back here. quick ask: if you take an action, add a one-line status update in this thread so we have a linear audit. :memo:

arjun: uploaded flamegraphs and perf archive: https://s3.redwood.internal/kv-shard-4/perf-3786543210.tar.gz — will update with analysis tomorrow. :eyes:

patrick: scheduled canary change in infra config at 2026-03-25T02:15Z. will post canary results.

carmen: heap-scan final CSV posted. a couple of suspect alloc sites in EncodeBulk and LRU promotion paths.

maria: closing loop: we'll review results Tue retro and decide on longer-term remediation (quotas, GC tuning, allocator changes). thanks all. :thumbsup:
